headlines.description: On Tuesday, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) announced that the United States had lost its measles elimination status, a distinction it had held for 26 years. headlines.name: FCC greenlights rule allowing prisons to jam cellphone signals
headlines.headline: FCC greenlights rule allowing prisons to jam cellphone signals
headlines.description: The Federal Communications Commission voted unanimously to allow state and local prisons to jam cellphones. In an announcement on Thursday , the FCC argues the rule will help combat an "influx of contraband cellphones" used to carry out crimes from prison. Jammers are generally banned under Section 333 of the Communications Act of 1934 , though they're used at some federal facilities.
